notes: Modified cash basis village, FY ended 9/30/2022, extracted like FY2023/FY2024. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5); no transfers printed. Roll-forward 1,355,032 + 789,647 - 469,517 = 1,675,162. Business-type (Electric, Water, Sewer) from the proprietary statement Total column (p7): 682,498 + 884,317 - 838,360 = 728,455; nonoperating 'Capital outlay' (94,680) recorded as a disbursement; nonoperating interest, grant income (no grantor printed) and sale of equipment recorded as receipts. Business-type 'Other revenue' is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities (808,780, p2). Proprietary cash flow statement (pp8-9) printed but proprietary left null as in later years (cash basis). ending_cash = governmental funds cash + county treasurer cash (p4); no beginning governmental cash printed. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4, totals equal government-wide 1,675,162), business-type lines and totals from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: General Fund from the General Fund departments combining statement (pp14-15; ties to 236,509 / 213,305); the General Fund budget schedule (p10) is the less detailed duplicate and is not recorded. Street and Community Development Agency budget schedules (pp11-12; CDA zero-actual Capital outlay not recorded), nonmajor combining statement (p13, Keno and Debt Service funds). 'Intergovernmental' kept as other state aid (no type printed). Proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule, so no business-type detail (as later years). Read pages 1-15 of 15
